text:
Olivia M.: Hey team — draft of the launch post is up: https://docs.google.com/.../draft (PLEASE read)
Olivia M.: Goal: finalize copy + benchmark narrative and CTA by EOD Wed so we can lock assets for the webinar next week. Need legal pass and design slices.
Emily B.: skimmed — overall +1. Thinking headline 2 reads stronger. Sharing quick alt headlines:
Emily B.: "Ship LLM inference you can trust" vs "Predictable LLM inference for production" — leaning first.
Mike P.: Prefer the second. It's more explicit re: production. Also can we call out Dedicated and Private briefly in the second paragraph?
Devin C.: Design can do hero image + benchmarking graphic. Will need final headline and H2 by Thursday 10am. Also attaching mock thumbnails in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd
Tariq R.: For inbound routing, can we add a webinar RSVP CTA that sets utm_source=webinar and tags leads for GTM? Suggest adding a gated slide deck download on thank-you page.
Olivia M.: Good call — @Tariq we'll add an intermediate /resource/ page. Emily can you add the CTA copy (two variants) to the doc?
Emily B.: On it. Two CTAs: "Register — See benchmark results" and "Get the benchmark report". Short and long copy in the doc.
Sarah L.: Quick legal pass: remove superlative claims like "fastest" unless we link to the benchmark table. Prefer "industry-leading" w/ footnote linking to methodology. Also avoid specific latency numbers unless they're in the benchmark table with test harness details.
Olivia M.: Noted. I'll swap "fastest" -> "industry-leading" and link to methodology section.
Mike P.: Also ping infra for an ops quote about regional routing. @Devin can you surface a small callout about region failover in the sidebar?
Devin C.: Yup — will reserve space. Need a short blurb (20-30 words). Mike, can you draft that?
Mike P.: Draft: "Redwood’s smart routing keeps latency stable across regions with automatic fallbacks and compatible model variants." Thoughts?
Tariq R.: Good. For the webinar, proposing Tuesday 10am PT. Emily, can you host the deck? Also we should add a signup field for company size to route to sales.
Emily B.: I can host. Will include a 1-question field (company size). Also will prep a follow-up email template.
Olivia M.: Great. Two outstanding items: legal language update (Sarah), design hero/thumbs (Devin), final headline decision (team). Can everyone check the doc again and add comments inline. Would love final approval by Thu 5pm.
Sarah L.: I'll review and comment by Thu noon.
Devin C.: Will upload updated figma comps by Thu 2pm.
Emily B.: I’ll finalize CTA + deck by Thu 4pm.
Tariq R.: I'll set up the webinar page, utm gating, and lead routing flows; aiming for Fri QA.
Olivia M.: Thanks all! :rocket: Please react with :thumbsup: when you've read.
Mike P.: 👍
Sarah L.: :thumbsup:
Devin C.: 👍
